# Booking Scraper

The Apify actor [`voyager/booking-scraper`](https://apify.com/voyager/booking-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.197**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Scrape Booking with this hotels scraper and get data about accommodation on Booking.com. You can crawl by keywords or URLs for hotel prices, ratings, addresses, number of reviews, stars. You can also download all that room and hotel data from Booking.com with a few clicks: CSV, JSON, HTML, and Excel

## Pricing

Pay per event — Scraped place result $0.005, Add-on: Additional hotel data $0.005, Actor Start $0.00005 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/voyager/booking-scraper) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/voyager-booking-scraper@0.0.197#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs: {}
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `search` | string \| null |  |  | Destination — Insert the destination name here, e.g. Amsterdam. |
| `startUrls` | array |  |  | Or use Start URLs instead — Insert URLs to start with instead of a destination name. Hotel search URL's filters will be applied, except for the ones in the scraper input. You can also use shared list URLs. These links are generated for properties you saved in your Booking.com account. |
| `maxItems` | integer |  |  | Max results per destination or URL — Limit the number of places to be scraped. Input a value over `1000` to activate the 'overcome 1000 results limit' feature. |
| `extractAdditionalHotelData` | boolean |  | `false` | Scrape additional hotel data ($) — Adds two fields to each hotel: surroundings (nearby points of interest and distances) and roomOfferings (available room types with details). |
| `propertyType` | string |  | `"none"` | Property type — Choose type of property |
| `sortBy` | string |  | `"distance_from_search"` | Order results by — Hotel attribute by which the results will be ordered |
| `minScore` | string |  |  | Minimum rating — Minimum rating of a hotel in "8.4" format. - Searching below a rating of `5` may be very inefficient, as it's not natively supported by Booking.com. |
| `starsCountFilter` | string |  | `"any"` | Stars count — Only scrape places with the selected stars count. Also includes Booking.com's apartment-like properties 'square' rating. |
| `currency` | string |  | `"USD"` | Preferred currency — Currency to be set on the website |
| `language` | string |  | `"en-gb"` | Language — Language to be set on the website (does not apply to reviews) |
| `checkIn` | string |  |  | Check-in date — Select the check-in date in format YYYY-MM-DD or {number} {unit}. - Input the date in the UTC timezone. Booking.com uses the UTC timezone for all check-in and check-out dates, so we do the same. |
| `checkOut` | string |  |  | Check-out date — Select the check-out date in format YYYY-MM-DD or {number} {unit}. - Input the date in the UTC timezone. Booking.com uses the UTC timezone for all check-in and check-out dates, so we do the same. |
| `flexWindow` | string |  |  | Stay date flexibility (days) — Number of days to flex around the check-in and check-out dates. E.g. setting `3` will scrape hotels with a possible date range up to 3 days before and 3 days after the selected dates. - **Applied per URL:** used for search-style start URLs (destination, region, coordin |
| `rooms` | integer |  | `1` | Number of rooms — Number of rooms for the availability and price search. |
| `adults` | integer |  | `2` | Number of adults — Number of adult guests for the availability and price search. |
| `children` | integer |  | `0` | Number of children — Number of child guests for the availability and price search. |
| `minMaxPrice` | string |  |  | Price range — Insert the minimum and maximum price per night, e.g. '100-150' or '100+'. |

## Output

The actor publishes no dataset schema, so `items` are untyped objects.
